strips.title: A day with the Instant Pot Duo — in real life

panels.head: Sunday, 4 p.m.
panels.text: Vera adds 1½ cups of water and the chili ingredients. The v5 manual says that is the 6-quart minimum.

panels.head: Seal and wait
panels.text: Lid arrow to lock, switch to Seal. The manual says reaching pressure can take up to 30 minutes.

panels.head: The weak spot
panels.text: Owners find the sealing ring fiddly. Press it in with no puckering, or the lid will not seal.

panels.head: Release time
panels.text: Chili and beans suit natural release; the float valve drops, then the lid turns off.
